raw_policy: Files are immutable byte-for-byte upstream snapshots; derived files are written outside this directory.

files.name: clintox.csv.gz
files.role: joined reference used for reconciliation only

semantic_sources.positive: AACT-derived drugs associated with clinical trials that failed for toxicity reasons
semantic_sources.negative_comparator: SWEETLEAD FDA-approved drugs without an AACT positive after parent normalization
semantic_sources.joined_reference: DeepChem/MoleculeNet clintox.csv.gz; validation only, not the authoritative reconstruction input

known_limitations: The historical positive list is source-processed rather than a current ClinicalTrials.gov refresh.
The negative class is an approved-drug comparator, not proof of universal absence of toxicity.
The upstream dataset license is not specified.
